feedback: The `blocker_moved` predicate is wrong. The specified truth condition is: the cell directly in front of the door holds no ball, i.e. `not any(cell is not None and cell.type == "ball" for cell in [env.grid.get(dx - 1, dy)])` where `(dx, dy)` is the door cell. The candidate instead iterates over all grid cells and returns true whenever there exists a cell `x,y` that is a door whose left neighbor `x-1, y` is not a ball — a completely different condition. It can be true when the ball is still in front of the door (e.g., if the ball is not exactly at `door.x - 1, door.y`, such as when the door faces another direction or the agent drops the ball somewhere else), and false in valid situations. It does not implement 'the blocking ball no longer prevents access to the locked door'. Replace `blocker_moved` with the documented expression: locate the door cell `(dx, dy)` and return `not any(c is not None and c.type == "ball" for c in [env.grid.get(dx - 1, dy)])`. The other four predicates (`has_door_key`, `door_open`, `target_picked_up`, `key_lost`) match the specification, read `previous_valuation` read-only, contain no imports/actions/side effects, and the function set is exactly the declared proposition set.
